note_text:
CC: hallux MTP pain with new midfoot stiffness

HPI: weeks of symptoms relating to thickened painful nails. Patient also reports a distinct symptom requiring separate evaluation. Sensory neuropathy noted on prior visits.

Exam: nails examined consistent with thickened painful nails; general inspection of the foot otherwise unremarkable.

MDM: addressed an independent problem with risks, data review (X-ray pending), and a management plan distinct from the procedure decision; shared decision making documented.

Procedure: Debridement of 1 to 5 thickened nails performed with sterile technique. Tolerated well, no immediate complications.
